title: deploy-unwind-debug-journal
content:
Personal debug journal / breadcrumbs for the 2026-03 canary unwind. Working notes, commands tried, errors captured, hypotheses and immediate next steps. Not a runbook yet — quick scratchpad for handoff.

Context:
- Canary rollout of v2026-03-08-rc2 to 5% traffic failed; full rollout aborted automatically by policy after 12m.
- Symptoms: increased 5xx rate from canary pods, some pods in crashloopbackoff, image pull failures reported on two nodes. Stable baseline (previous release v2026-02-27) unaffected.
- Pipeline: GitHub Actions -> publish to internal registry -> ArgoCD promotes image tag to canary kustomize overlay.

Timeline + what I did (timestamps UTC):
- 2026-03-08 14:02: CI job ci/publish-image succeeded (build-8923). Image: registry.internal.redwood:5000/inference/serve:v2026-03-08-rc2 -> pushed with tag and digest sha256:6a1b...f3e.
- 2026-03-08 14:05: ArgoCD synced canary overlay to point at tag v2026-03-08-rc2 (argocd sync initiated by GH Action).
- 2026-03-08 14:09: Alerts: canary 5xx > 1% threshold.
- 2026-03-08 14:11: Observed two pods with ImagePullBackOff on ip-10-2-xx-yy and ip-10-2-xx-zz.
- 2026-03-08 14:12: Pulled logs from kubelet, saw: "rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to fetch anonymous token: unexpected status: 401 Unauthorized" on those nodes.
- 2026-03-08 14:13: In CI logs, noticed publish-image step used registry token from runner ephemeral creds; image push reported OK.
- 2026-03-08 14:16: Attempted kubectl rollout undo on deployment/inference-serve --namespace=prod-canary but rollouts are managed by ArgoCD (undo reverted, ArgoCD re-applied desired state instantly).
- 2026-03-08 14:18: Patched ArgoCD app to point to previous tag v2026-02-27 and forced a sync; canary pods replaced, traffic dropped back to baseline after 6m.
- 2026-03-08 14:30: Follow-up: artifacts and registry state inconsistent between eu-west and us-east mirror registries.

Commands and snippets I used (copy/paste friendly):
- Check pods and events:
  kubectl -n prod-canary get pods -o wide
  kubectl -n prod-canary describe pod inference-serve-xxx

- Inspect image on node (ssh into node):
  sudo crictl images | grep inference/serve
  sudo journalctl -u kubelet | tail -n 200 | grep -i image

- Verify registry digest and local pull:
  docker pull registry.internal.redwood:5000/inference/serve:v2026-03-08-rc2 || true
  docker inspect registry.internal.redwood:5000/inference/serve:v2026-03-08-rc2 --format '{{.RepoDigests}}'

- ArgoCD ops (used UI + CLI):
  argocd app get inference-serving-prod --refresh
  argocd app set inference-serving-prod --revision v2026-02-27 && argocd app sync inference-serving-prod --prune

- attempted transient workaround (not ideal):
  kubectl -n prod-canary set image deployment/inference-serve inference=registry.internal.redwood:5000/inference/serve@sha256:6a1b...f3e && kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-serve -n prod-canary
  -> ArgoCD re-deployed tag-based manifest on next reconciliation (race).

Observed error snippets: (copied from node and kube events)
- "Failed to pull image \"registry.internal.redwood:5000/inference/serve:v2026-03-08-rc2\": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to fetch anonymous token: unexpected status: 401 Unauthorized"
- Registry api returned intermittent 502 when queried from us-east nodes around 14:20.
- CI publish step recorded: "push complete" and returned digest sha256:6a1b...f3e but registry-webhook reported a warning "replication delayed for tag v2026-03-08-rc2".

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Token/replication race: image push to primary registry completed, digest recorded, but mirrors/replication to edge registries lagged and ArgoCD-target nodes tried to pull before replication finished -> some nodes hit 404/401 from edge registry.
2) Registry auth edge-case: ephemeral CI creds used to push image lacked proper replication metadata so mirror auth failed (401).
3) ArgoCD manifest uses tag (not digest) which allowed transient mismatch between tag and digest across registries. Tag promotion sans atomic digest caused non-deterministic pulls.
4) Not likely but possible: image garbage collection or cleanup job removed intermediate layer on some nodes concurrently (unlikely given timestamps).

Why the rollback/unwind was awkward:
- ArgoCD is the source-of-truth; kubectl interventions are ephemeral and will be reverted on sync. We need either to update Git (manifest) or temporarily pause ArgoCD sync.
- The pipeline assumes tag consistency across registries; no enforcement of digest pinning for promoted releases.

Immediate remediation checklist (what worked):
- Paused ArgoCD auto-sync for inference-serving-prod (argocd app set --sync-policy none) to allow manual recovery window.
- Manually pointed manifests in Git to prior tag and triggered ArgoCD sync.
- Notified infra to check registry replication queues and to re-run replication for v2026-03-08-rc2 to both mirrors.
- Reapplied new canary only after registry mirrors healthy and digest verified on all nodes.

Commands that fixed traffic quickly:
- argocd app set inference-serving-prod --sync-policy none
- Update Git kustomize overlay (temp): replace image: inference/serve:v2026-03-08-rc2 -> v2026-02-27, push, then argocd app sync inference-serving-prod --prune

Next steps / TODOs (actionable tech items):
- Short term (this week):
  - Enforce CI image publish step to publish with both tag and manifest list and validate replication before merging PR that advances ArgoCD. Add a replication-check step. (Owner: Jun)
  - Change ArgoCD overlay to accept digest pins for canary promotion, or have promotion write digest into kustomize image. (Owner: me)
  - Add a pre-rollout hook that verifies imageDigest presence on a sample node in target region before allowing >0% traffic. (Owner: SRE team request)

- Medium term (1-2 sprints):
  - Make image promotion atomic: CI publishes image, writes digest to a release manifest in Git (release-manifests/), then ArgoCD picks that manifest. Avoid tag-only promotion.
  - Add observability: registry replication lag metric and an alert when replication lags > 2m for a pushed tag.
  - Document a standard rollback/unwind runbook for ArgoCD-managed deployments (what to patch in Git, how to pause, acceptable emergency kubectl patches and how to hold ArgoCD).

Notes to self / gotchas:
- If you need to force a transient workaround in prod and ArgoCD is still active, use argocd app set --sync-policy none first. Otherwise your kubectl update will be undone.
- Use digest pinning when possible for critical canaries. Using tags is easier but brittle across replica registries.
- When calling infra/registry team include the image digest and timestamp and the CI build id (build-8923) — saves back-and-forth.

Handoff checklist for whoever picks this up:
- Attach CI logs (ci/publish-image build-8923) and ArgoCD sync event around 14:05–14:20.
- Share node journal snippets (kubelet) from ip-10-2-xx-yy and ip-10-2-xx-zz.
- Confirm replication state for v2026-03-08-rc2 on registry-primary and mirrors.

If I remember: I also saw a later advisory from registry team about a brief auth token expiry bug happening 2026-03-08 13:58–14:10 which could explain 401s — correlate their logs with our node failures.

End of notes. Keep this as the single source for the initial troubleshooting chain; will extract a polished postmortem and runbook if we need to repeat this pattern.
